1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material
brought on record.

2. This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No. 248 of 2022,
under Sections - 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Manda,
District- Prayagraj with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.

entities.text:
Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Manda,
District- Prayagraj
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is father-in-law of deceased.

The marriage of deceased with son of applicant has taken place about four years prior to the incident and out of that marriage,
they have a child.
Only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons and no specific role has been assigned to the applicant.
It was stated that on 30.08.2022 the uncle of deceased has passed away and she had committed suicide under the depression.

In postmortem report, no injury has been shown on the body of the Lal Bahadur vs State Of U.P. on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15044072/

sentences.text: As per FSL report, aluminium phosphide has been found in the viscera of deceased.
It was stated that during investigation, applicant was granted interim anticipatory bail and he has never misused the liberty of anticipatory bail.

The co-accused Ram Raghav Prajapati @ Doctor and Mangira, who are husband and mother-in-law of deceased respectively, have already been granted bail by this Court vide orders dated 29.02.2024 & 25.10.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 59603 of 2022 &
38045 of 2024.

entities.text:
Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 59603 of 2022 &
38045 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in jail since 24.09.2024, and that in case applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
6. The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant - Lal Bahadur involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv.
The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

v. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
8. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.
